name: names-of-israel-source
description: Sources and build tools for the Names of Israel site. The deployable output lives one level up (src/).

scripts.site: python3 tools/meanings.py && python3 tools/arabic.py && python3 tools/build_site.py && python3 tools/check_site.py
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' && python3 tools/check_site.py
scripts.build: npm run bundle && npm run seo && npm run site
